feature_catalog.name: age_seconds
feature_catalog.formula: cutoff_time - creation_time

feature_catalog.name: curve_progress
feature_catalog.formula: completed fraction under protocol reserve/completion definition; retain formula_id
feature_catalog.missingness: null if reserves unknown; never a fixed SOL threshold

feature_catalog.name: round_trip_cost_fraction
feature_catalog.formula: (entry_cash - immediate_modeled_exit_cash) / entry_cash

feature_catalog.name: entry_impact_bps
feature_catalog.formula: execution-average versus pretrade marginal price

feature_catalog.name: buy_count_W
feature_catalog.formula: successful buy counts in (t-W, t]
feature_catalog.missingness: zero only when window coverage complete

feature_catalog.name: sell_count_W
feature_catalog.formula: successful sell counts in (t-W, t]
feature_catalog.missingness: zero only when window coverage complete

feature_catalog.name: buy_quote_W
feature_catalog.formula: sum of buy quote amounts

feature_catalog.name: sell_quote_W
feature_catalog.formula: sum of sell quote amounts

feature_catalog.name: unique_buyers_W
feature_catalog.formula: distinct trader owner wallets

feature_catalog.name: buyer_arrival_rate_W
feature_catalog.formula: newly observed buyers in W / W seconds

feature_catalog.name: buyer_arrival_acceleration
feature_catalog.formula: current arrival rate - prior equal-window rate

feature_catalog.name: repeat_buyer_ratio_W
feature_catalog.formula: buyers with at least two buys / unique buyers

feature_catalog.name: buyer_retention_W
feature_catalog.formula: buyers still holding positive inventory / buyers

feature_catalog.name: wallet_churn_W
feature_catalog.formula: full-exit sellers / starting holders
feature_catalog.missingness: null if starting balance coverage absent

feature_catalog.name: buy_size_p10_W
feature_catalog.formula: p10 of buy quote amounts

feature_catalog.name: buy_size_p50_W
feature_catalog.formula: p50 of buy quote amounts

feature_catalog.name: buy_size_p90_W
feature_catalog.formula: p90 of buy quote amounts

feature_catalog.name: buy_size_cv_W
feature_catalog.formula: stdev / mean of buy sizes
feature_catalog.missingness: null if fewer than two observations

feature_catalog.name: interarrival_cv_W
feature_catalog.formula: stdev / mean of inter-trade gaps
feature_catalog.missingness: null if fewer than three trades

feature_catalog.name: sell_acceleration_W
feature_catalog.formula: current sell quote/sec - previous equal-window sell quote/sec

feature_catalog.name: largest_seller_share_W
feature_catalog.formula: max wallet sell quote / total sell quote

feature_catalog.name: return_W
feature_catalog.formula: current executable price / executable price W ago - 1
feature_catalog.missingness: null if quote unavailable at either endpoint

feature_catalog.name: realized_volatility_W
feature_catalog.formula: sqrt(sum of squared log executable-price increments)

feature_catalog.name: net_creator_flow_W
feature_catalog.formula: creator-linked buy quote - sell quote, link as-of cutoff
feature_catalog.missingness: null if graph required but absent

feature_catalog.name: holder_top_k_share
feature_catalog.formula: sum of top k eligible holder balances / circulating eligible supply

feature_catalog.name: holder_hhi
feature_catalog.formula: sum of squared eligible holder supply shares

feature_catalog.name: cluster_hhi
feature_catalog.formula: HHI after high-confidence cluster aggregation

feature_catalog.name: independent_cluster_count
feature_catalog.formula: high-confidence clusters + unclustered wallets
feature_catalog.missingness: null plus coverage field if history incomplete

feature_catalog.name: creator_linked_supply_share
feature_catalog.formula: creator/linked cohort supply / eligible supply

feature_catalog.name: fresh_wallet_share
feature_catalog.formula: early buyers first observed within 24h / early buyers

feature_catalog.name: immediate_funding_share
feature_catalog.formula: early buyers funded within 5 minutes before first buy / covered early buyers

feature_catalog.name: funding_diversity
feature_catalog.formula: exp(Shannon entropy of material funding-source shares)

feature_catalog.name: cohort_recurrence
feature_catalog.formula: prior shared launches passing recurrence/timing rules, excluding current outcome

feature_catalog.name: co_buy_density
feature_catalog.formula: durable behavioural edges / possible edges
feature_catalog.missingness: null if fewer than two buyers

feature_catalog.name: weighted_degree_concentration
feature_catalog.formula: largest weighted degree / sum of degrees

feature_catalog.name: cohort_modularity
feature_catalog.formula: modularity of pinned weighted community run

feature_catalog.name: smart_wallet_retention
feature_catalog.formula: reputation-weighted retained inventory / bought inventory

feature_catalog.name: wallet_skill_posterior_mean
feature_catalog.formula: weighted mean of point-in-time reputation posteriors
feature_catalog.missingness: null if no matured wallet history

feature_catalog.name: wallet_skill_effective_sample
feature_catalog.formula: effective sample size of reputation evidence
feature_catalog.missingness: null if no matured wallet history

feature_catalog.name: creator_graduation_posterior
feature_catalog.formula: shrunk graduation rate on matured prior launches

feature_catalog.name: creator_collapse_posterior
feature_catalog.formula: shrunk severe-collapse rate under pinned label definition

feature_catalog.name: history_coverage_fraction
feature_catalog.formula: relevant wallets with required history range / relevant wallets
feature_catalog.missingness: zero is valid; unknown remains unknown
